      BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


       SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code ofChicago, the Chicago Zoning

Ordinance be amended by changing all the B3-2 Communily Shopping District symbols

and indications as shown on Map No. 11-H in the area bounded by

       a line 339.50 feet north of and parallel to West Cullom Avenue; the alley
       next east of and parallel to North Western Avenue; a line 314.60 feet north
       of West Cullom Avenue; and North Western Avenue,


to those of a B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

passage and due publication.
